faq.title: Questions brands ask before choosing a platform
faq.description: Short answers with direct links to the relevant pages.

items.question: How do we choose between Lumi, Venus, and Themis?
items.answer: Start with the three main categories: cooling (Venus), app-guided routines (Lumi), and professional energy (Themis). Compare the full lineup in the catalogue, then request a sample of the two closest matches.

items.question: What can be customized on each platform?
items.answer: Every platform supports logo printing, user manual customization, and box insert customization. Cosmetic changes (color, finish, and materials) are available on most platforms.

items.question: Can we start with a small pilot order?
items.answer: Yes. Start with no MOQ and a single unit for sampling. Once validated, scale to bulk pricing tiers.

items.question: Do you support dropshipping or direct shipping to our customers?
items.answer: Yes. iShine supports packing and shipping directly to your customers, including custom inserts and kitting.
